observer_contract.method: Replay the exact frozen R18 compile_cnf -> occurrence elimination_order -> per-variable Dag.exists -> Dag.gc sequence using the imported frozen R18 Budget, Dag, compile_cnf, elimination_order and ResourceLimit primitives. Add observation only around the same operations; do not alter them.

observer_equivalence_gate.purpose: The forensic observer has no authority on OPEN worlds unless it exactly reproduces deterministic frozen-candidate counters on all four completed R19 PASS worlds.

frozen_forensic_landmarks.report: For each world report the earliest completed step crossing each threshold, normalized elimination progress step/total_internal, the peak completed pre-GC step, the peak completed after-GC step, and if OPEN the partial current step at deadline. Thresholds are descriptive landmarks only, not claims of asymptotic phase transitions.

comparison_plan: Compare W01-W04 PASS trajectories with W05-W08 OPEN trajectories at equal normalized elimination progress.
Determine whether OPEN occurs before or after the active-node peak and how much support remains at deadline.
Separate retained active-node growth from temporary-node churn removed by GC.
Measure restrict calls and nodes created per eliminated variable; do not collapse them into one invented complexity unit.
Identify whether n72/n80 OPEN is dominated by retained DAG width, temporary construction churn, restrict recursion, or a mixture.

dominance_rule.retained_node_dominated: At OPEN, active_nodes_at_open >= 500000 on at least 3 of 4 OPEN worlds and partial/current-step restrict calls do not alone explain all OPENs.
dominance_rule.temporary_churn_dominated: At least 3 of 4 OPEN worlds cross cumulative_nodes_created >= 1000000 while active_nodes_at_open < 500000 and GC has removed a majority of all created nodes before OPEN.
dominance_rule.restrict_dominated: At least 3 of 4 OPEN worlds cross cumulative_restrict_calls >= 2000000 before OPEN while active_nodes_at_open < 500000.
dominance_rule.mixed: No single preregistered dominance rule covers at least 3 of 4 OPEN worlds, but at least two resource mechanisms independently cover different OPEN worlds.

next_action_rule: R20 may recommend a new R21 representation or scheduling hypothesis only after preserving the observed wall. R20 itself must not modify R18, rerun R19 with larger limits, or convert OPEN into PASS/FAIL.
claim_ceiling: Resource forensics on eight finite frozen worlds only. No asymptotic complexity law, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP conclusion.
